questions: Trace declared versus escalated chains and quota_pool/model cooldown identities.
Preserve exit 75 and zero functional-failure increments for availability faults.
decision: Keep availability as a separate bounded state machine, with stable provider/model/quota-pool identity and no functional-failure inflation.
code_observations: availability.read accepts a bounded version1 ledger with cooldowns, per-phase state and compact events; unavailable records categorized failures rather than raw model output.

availability.select fingerprints route inputs, derives a chain and applies visited/cooldown/CLI checks. The current fixed failure slot and escalated-tier chain must not leak into the new coherent switching policy.
workload_routing identity and cooldown keys already distinguish provider profiles and pools; reuse them instead of adding a second incompatible identity scheme.
implementation_steps: Specify a stable candidate identity containing host, backend profile, resolved model and quota pool, with null for unknown metadata. Never store endpoint credentials.
Preserve exit75 when no allowed candidate is currently available. Bound probes and attempts per run; honor cooldown before consulting a paid model.
Add an availability-intent contract for the future switch controller: candidate order and effective rung are explicit; the selector must not secretly rebuild a different semantic chain.
Fingerprint every option that changes candidate construction, including phase and switch configuration. Keep version1 ledgers readable and discard only stale cached intent, not useful cooldowns.
Differentiate missing executable, authentication, quota, transient capacity and invalid model. An invalid model triggers bounded catalog repair or a plan defect, not unlimited provider cycling.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Quota in one configured pool does not block another pool unless the configuration explicitly shares it.
Availability failures leave functional failure counts and semantic ladder evidence unchanged.
Fallback-disabled and CLI-pinned cases never widen the allowed chain.
A changed route fingerprint invalidates cached intent while retaining unrelated valid cooldowns.
Every eligible unavailable candidate yields a bounded, redacted reason; all-unavailable returns75 without a spin loop.

alternatives.title: Treat every nonzero result as a failed implementation
alternatives.tradeoff: Simple but burns semantic attempts on quota and missing tools.

alternatives.title: Separate availability ledger with explicit intent
alternatives.tradeoff: Reuses existing primitives and makes routing decisions reproducible.

alternatives.title: Delegate availability decisions to a monitoring LLM
alternatives.tradeoff: Adds cost to a deterministic decision and risks ignoring policy or cooldown state.

cost_model: No model call is needed to classify explicit quota/auth/CLI failures. Measure avoided paid redispatches and time to eligible fallback; do not count unknown quota as free capacity.
unverified: Provider error strings and quota grouping can change. Live account discovery is unverified here and must be stored as dated evidence.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
